basic_info.description: Come see this charming 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo with a bonus office space nestled in the vibrant heart of San Francisco. An open concept living / dining room features hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and double pane large windows that flood the space with natural light. The elegant open kitchen is complete with granite counters, ample cabinet space, and stainless steel appliances. Delight in the beautifully tiled bathroom with a glass half-wall shower. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer, plus a designated garage space with electric vehicle charging. Location is prime within 2 blocks from most public transportation, less than 10 mins walk to Bart, and with quick access to Hwy 101. Additionally, find local restaurants & grocery stores within a quick walk down the block and less than a half mile to Zuckerberg San Francisco hospital. Come see this unit before its gone!
